server = function(input, output, session) {
  
  # Unified SQLite connection for the session, closed on session end
  db_conn <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), sql_db_file)
  session$onSessionEnded(function() {
    if(DBI::dbIsValid(db_conn)) {
      DBI::dbDisconnect(db_conn)
    }
  })
  
  logout_init <- shinyauthr::logoutServer(
    id = "logout",
    active = reactive(credentials()$user_auth)
  )
  
  credentials <- shinyauthr::loginServer(
    id = "login", 
    data = user_base,
    user_col = user,
    pwd_col = password_hash,
    sodium_hashed = TRUE,
    log_out = reactive(logout_init())
  )
  
  observe({
    if(credentials()$user_auth) {
      shinyjs::removeClass(selector = "body", class = "sidebar-collapse")
    } else {
      shinyjs::addClass(selector = "body", class = "sidebar-collapse")
    }
  })
  
  output$kplr_id <- renderUI({
    if(credentials()$user_auth) {
      return(selectInput(inputId = "kplr_id", label = "Select Kepler ID:",
                         choices = options, selected = options[1]))
    }
  })
  
  # Live "does this star need more tagging?" readout for whichever star is
  # currently selected. Uses the posterior MEAN (not a fresh random draw)
  # so the badge doesn't visibly flicker on every re-render - only the
  # "Suggest Next Star" button below draws a fresh Thompson sample.
  output$star_priority_badge <- renderUI({
    req(credentials()$user_auth, input$kplr_id)
    tag_save_trigger()
    st <- compute_star_bandit_stats(db_conn, current_star_id())
    label <- switch(st$source,
      "cold-start"    = "Not tagged by anyone yet",
      "single-tagger" = "Tagged by 1 user so far",
      "human-model"   = sprintf("1 user \u2014 %.0f%% match with model detection", 100 * st$mean_agree),
      "human-human"   = sprintf("%d users \u2014 %.0f%% pairwise agreement", st$n_human, 100 * st$mean_agree))
    priority_mean <- st$alpha_disagree / (st$alpha_disagree + st$alpha_agree)
    tier <- if (priority_mean > 0.6) "High priority" else if (priority_mean > 0.35) "Medium priority" else "Low priority"
    color <- if (priority_mean > 0.6) "#dc2626" else if (priority_mean > 0.35) "#d97706" else "#16a34a"
    div(style = "font-size: 0.8em; color: #ccc;",
        span(style = paste0("display:inline-block; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:10px; background:",
                             color, "; color:white; font-weight:bold;"), tier),
        div(style = "margin-top:4px;", label)
    )
  })
  
  # Thompson-Sampling star recommendation: draws one fresh sample per star
  # from compute_star_bandit_stats() and jumps the dropdown to whichever
  # star that sample favors.
  observeEvent(input$bandit_suggest, {
    req(credentials()$user_auth)
    ranked <- rank_stars_by_bandit(db_conn, options)
    pick <- ranked[1, ]
    updateSelectInput(session, "kplr_id", selected = pick$star)
    msg <- if (pick$n_human == 0) {
      sprintf("Suggested %s \u2014 no one has tagged it yet.", pick$star)
    } else {
      sprintf("Suggested %s \u2014 tagged by %d user(s), ~%.0f%% agreement so far.",
              pick$star, pick$n_human, 100 * pick$mean_agree)
    }
    showNotification(msg, type = "message", duration = 6)
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$signup, {
    refresh <- F
    if(input$user == "") {
      output$error <- renderText(return('<font color = "red"><b>Username cannot be blank!<b></font>'))
    }
    if(input$password == "") {
      output$error <- renderText(return('<font color = "red"><b>Password cannot be blank!<b></font>'))
    }
    if(input$name == "") {
      output$error <- renderText(return('<font color = "red"><b>Name cannot be empty!<b></font>'))
    }
    if(input$name != "" & input$password != "" & input$user != "") {
      current_users <- dbGetQuery(db_conn, "SELECT * FROM user_base;")
      if(input$user %in% current_users$user) {
        output$error <- renderText(return('<font color = "red"><b>Username already exists. Please enter a differnet username!<b></font>'))
      } else {
        passwd_hsh <- sodium::password_store(input$password)
        insert_query <- paste0("INSERT INTO user_base VALUES('", input$user, "', '", passwd_hsh, "', '", input$permissions, "', '", input$name, "');")
        dbExecute(db_conn, insert_query)
        output$error <- renderText(return('<font color = "green"><b>Signup successful! Please refresh the page before attempting to login<b></font>'))
        refresh <- T
      }
    }
    user_base <<- dbGetQuery(db_conn, "SELECT * FROM user_base;")
    if(refresh) {
      shinyjs::refresh()
    }
  })
  
  # Helper to retrieve candidate indices from user_star or test_idx
  get_candidate_indices <- function(id, username) {
    query <- paste0("SELECT * FROM user_star WHERE user_id='", username,
                    "' AND kepler_id=", id, ";")
    query_result <- dbGetQuery(db_conn, query)
    if(nrow(query_result) == 0) {
      query <- paste0("SELECT * FROM test_idx WHERE id=", id, ";")
      query_result <- dbGetQuery(db_conn, query)
    }
    if(nrow(query_result) > 0) {
      return(list(starts = query_result$start, ends = query_result$end))
    }
    return(list(starts = 0, ends = 0))
  }
  
  # Helper: current star's numeric Kepler id, from the selected dropdown value
  current_star_id <- reactive({
    req(input$kplr_id)
    as.integer(gsub(strsplit(input$kplr_id, "_")[[1]][1],
                    pattern = "kplr", replacement = ""))
  })
  
  # Reactive state for zoom boundaries
  zoom_state <- reactiveValues(xlim = NULL)
  
  # The user's saved tag windows for the currently selected star (falls back
  # to model-detected candidates when the user has no saved tags of their own)
  saved_indices <- reactiveVal(list(starts = 0, ends = 0))
  
  refresh_saved_indices <- function() {
    req(input$kplr_id)
    saved_indices(get_candidate_indices(current_star_id(), user_info()$name))
    # Sync the flag state for the current user/star from the DB
    flag_q <- tryCatch(
      dbGetQuery(db_conn,
        "SELECT flagged FROM user_star WHERE user_id = ? AND kepler_id = ? AND flagged = 1 LIMIT 1;",
        params = list(user_info()$name, current_star_id())),
      error = function(e) data.frame(flagged = integer(0)))
    star_flagged(nrow(flag_q) > 0L)
  }
  
  # --- Manual tagging session state -----------------------------------
  # tag_windows: list of c(start, end) cadence-index pairs for the current session.
  # tag_labels:  parallel list of label strings ("Transit", "Sinusoidal", etc.).
  # last_window_label: persists the label picker choice across toolbar re-renders.
  tag_mode         <- reactiveVal(FALSE)
  tag_windows      <- reactiveVal(list())
  tag_labels       <- reactiveVal(list())
  last_window_label <- reactiveVal("Transit")
  tag_redraw_trigger <- reactiveVal(0)    # bumped only on STRUCTURAL changes
  bump_tag_redraw  <- function() tag_redraw_trigger(isolate(tag_redraw_trigger()) + 1)

  # Per-session classification counter shown in the sidebar.
  session_counts <- reactiveValues(n_transit = 0L, n_no_transit = 0L)

  # Per-star flag state for the current user (synced from DB by refresh_saved_indices).
  star_flagged <- reactiveVal(FALSE)

  # Per-star cache of score_star() results keyed by kplr_id dropdown value.
  # Avoids re-running the (potentially expensive) model inference on every
  # zoom / window-drag; cleared implicitly when the session ends.
  star_data_cache <- reactiveVal(list())

  # Result of the most recent BLS period search; NULL until "Verify Period" is run.
  bls_result <- reactiveVal(NULL)
  
  # Odd-even / secondary-eclipse vetting results for the last BLS search.
  vetting_result <- reactiveVal(NULL)
  
  # Bumped whenever a tagging change is saved so the star-priority badge recomputes.
  tag_save_trigger <- reactiveVal(0)
  
  # NULL when the plot used a real model prediction; otherwise a fallback reason code.
  model_fallback_state <- reactiveVal(NULL)
  
  # Fast triage result for the most-recently rendered star.
  triage_state <- reactiveVal(NULL)
  
  # Whether the "Community Tags" panel is expanded.
  community_tags_visible <- reactiveVal(FALSE)

  # Keep last_window_label in sync with the live selectInput in tag mode
  observe({
    req(input$window_label)
    last_window_label(input$window_label)
  })
  
  output$tag_window_summary <- renderText({
    w    <- tag_windows()
    lbls <- tag_labels()
    if (length(w) == 0) {
      "No windows fixed yet. Drag-select a range on the plot, then click 'Fix Brush as Window'."
    } else {
      parts <- mapply(function(win, lbl) {
        d0 <- round((win[1] - 1L) * cadence_days, 2)
        d1 <- round((win[2] - 1L) * cadence_days, 2)
        paste0("[", d0, "\u2013", d1, " d | ", lbl, "]")
      }, w, if (length(lbls) == length(w)) lbls else rep("Transit", length(w)),
      SIMPLIFY = TRUE)
      paste0(length(w), " window(s): ", paste(parts, collapse = ", "))
    }
  })
  
  # Reset zoom/tagging state when a different star is selected
  observeEvent(input$kplr_id, {
    zoom_state$xlim <- NULL
    tag_mode(FALSE)
    tag_windows(list())
    tag_labels(list())
    bls_result(NULL)
    vetting_result(NULL)
    star_flagged(FALSE)  # overwritten synchronously by refresh_saved_indices() below
    refresh_saved_indices()
  })
  
  # Zoom into current drag-selection (view mode only).
  # sel$x is in day-units (x-axis); convert back to cadence indices for zoom_state.
  observeEvent(input$zoom_brush, {
    req(!isTRUE(tag_mode()))
    sel <- event_data("plotly_selected", source = "trainPlot_src")
    if (!is.null(sel) && nrow(sel) > 0) {
      st <- max(1L, as.integer(floor(min(sel$x) / cadence_days)) + 1L)
      en <- as.integer(ceiling(max(sel$x) / cadence_days)) + 1L
      if (en > st + 3L) zoom_state$xlim <- c(st, en)
    }
  })
  
  # Enter tagging mode, pre-loaded with the star's currently saved tags + labels
  observeEvent(input$start_tagging, {
    wins <- indices_to_windows(saved_indices())
    tag_windows(wins)
    # Load saved labels; NULL/NA fall back to "Transit" for backward compat
    if (length(wins) > 0L) {
      lbl_res <- tryCatch(
        dbGetQuery(db_conn,
          "SELECT start, label FROM user_star WHERE user_id = ? AND kepler_id = ? AND start > 0 ORDER BY start;",
          params = list(user_info()$name, current_star_id())),
        error = function(e) data.frame(start = integer(0), label = character(0)))
      if (nrow(lbl_res) == 0L) {
        lbl_res <- tryCatch(
          dbGetQuery(db_conn,
            "SELECT start, label FROM test_idx WHERE id = ? AND start > 0 ORDER BY start;",
            params = list(current_star_id())),
          error = function(e) data.frame(start = integer(0), label = character(0)))
      }
      if (nrow(lbl_res) > 0L) {
        saved_lbls <- lbl_res$label
        saved_lbls[is.na(saved_lbls) | !nzchar(saved_lbls)] <- "Transit"
        tag_labels(as.list(saved_lbls))
      } else {
        tag_labels(rep(list("Transit"), length(wins)))
      }
    } else {
      tag_labels(list())
    }
    tag_mode(TRUE)
    bump_tag_redraw()
  })
  
  # Enter tagging mode with a blank slate (nothing written until user confirms)
  observeEvent(input$customize, {
    tag_windows(list())
    tag_labels(list())
    tag_mode(TRUE)
    bump_tag_redraw()
  })
  
  # Fix the current drag-selection as a new tag window.
  # sel$x is in day-units; convert to cadence indices before storing.
  observeEvent(input$fix_brush, {
    req(isTRUE(tag_mode()))
    sel <- event_data("plotly_selected", source = "trainPlot_src")
    if (is.null(sel) || nrow(sel) == 0) {
      showNotification("Drag-select a range on the plot first, then click 'Fix Brush as Window'.", type = "warning")
      return(invisible(NULL))
    }
    st <- max(1L, as.integer(floor(min(sel$x) / cadence_days)) + 1L)
    en <- as.integer(ceiling(max(sel$x) / cadence_days)) + 1L
    if (en <= st + 1L) {
      showNotification("Selected range is too small.", type = "warning")
      return(invisible(NULL))
    }
    windows <- tag_windows()
    windows[[length(windows) + 1]] <- c(st, en)
    tag_windows(windows)
    lbl <- isolate(last_window_label())
    if (!nzchar(lbl)) lbl <- "Transit"
    labels <- tag_labels()
    labels[[length(labels) + 1]] <- lbl
    tag_labels(labels)
    bump_tag_redraw()
  })
  
  # Remove the most recently fixed window (and its label)
  observeEvent(input$undo_window, {
    req(isTRUE(tag_mode()))
    windows <- tag_windows()
    if (length(windows) > 0L) {
      windows[[length(windows)]] <- NULL
      tag_windows(windows)
      labels <- tag_labels()
      if (length(labels) > 0L) {
        labels[[length(labels)]] <- NULL
        tag_labels(labels)
      }
      bump_tag_redraw()
    }
  })
  
  # Sync edge-drag / move edits on fixed window shapes back into tag_windows.
  # shapes[i].x0/.x1 are in day-units (matching the plot x-axis); convert
  # back to cadence indices before storing. Does NOT bump tag_redraw: plotly
  # has already updated the shape client-side, so no full rebuild is needed.
  observeEvent(event_data("plotly_relayout", source = "trainPlot_src"), {
    req(isTRUE(tag_mode()))
    ed <- event_data("plotly_relayout", source = "trainPlot_src")
    if (is.null(ed)) return(invisible(NULL))
    shape_keys <- grep("^shapes\\[[0-9]+\\]\\.(x0|x1)$", names(ed), value = TRUE)
    if (length(shape_keys) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))
    windows <- tag_windows()
    for (k in shape_keys) {
      m <- regmatches(k, regexec("^shapes\\[([0-9]+)\\]\\.(x0|x1)$", k))[[1]]
      i <- as.integer(m[2]) + 1L  # shapes[] is 0-indexed in plotly.js
      coord <- m[3]
      val_day <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(ed[[k]]))
      if (i >= 1L && i <= length(windows) && !is.na(val_day)) {
        # day -> cadence index: idx = floor(day/cd)+1 for left edge, ceiling+1 for right
        val_idx <- if (coord == "x0") {
          max(1L, as.integer(floor(val_day / cadence_days)) + 1L)
        } else {
          as.integer(ceiling(val_day / cadence_days)) + 1L
        }
        if (coord == "x0") windows[[i]][1] <- val_idx else windows[[i]][2] <- val_idx
      }
    }
    windows <- lapply(windows, function(w) c(min(w), max(w)))
    tag_windows(windows)
  }, ignoreNULL = TRUE, ignoreInit = TRUE)
  
  # Save all fixed windows (with labels) to the database as the user's tagged data.
  observeEvent(input$confirm_tags, {
    req(isTRUE(tag_mode()))
    username <- user_info()$name
    id       <- current_star_id()
    windows  <- tag_windows()
    labels   <- isolate(tag_labels())
    ts       <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S")
    dbExecute(db_conn, "DELETE FROM user_star WHERE user_id = ? AND kepler_id = ?;",
              params = list(username, id))
    if (length(windows) == 0L) {
      dbExecute(db_conn,
        "INSERT INTO user_star (user_id, kepler_id, start, end, label, flagged, classified_at) VALUES (?, ?, 0, 0, 'no_transit', 0, ?);",
        params = list(username, id, ts))
      session_counts$n_no_transit <- isolate(session_counts$n_no_transit) + 1L
    } else {
      for (j in seq_along(windows)) {
        w   <- windows[[j]]
        lbl <- if (j <= length(labels) && nzchar(as.character(labels[[j]]))) labels[[j]] else "Transit"
        dbExecute(db_conn,
          "INSERT INTO user_star (user_id, kepler_id, start, end, label, flagged, classified_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0, ?);",
          params = list(username, id, floor(w[1]), ceiling(w[2]), lbl, ts))
      }
      session_counts$n_transit <- isolate(session_counts$n_transit) + 1L
    }
    tag_mode(FALSE)
    tag_windows(list())
    tag_labels(list())
    refresh_saved_indices()
    tag_save_trigger(isolate(tag_save_trigger()) + 1)
    n_wins <- length(windows)
    msg <- if (n_wins == 0L) "No Transit saved." else paste0("Saved ", n_wins, " window(s).")
    showNotification(msg, type = "message", duration = 4)
    # Surface the next recommended star
    ranked <- rank_stars_by_bandit(db_conn, options)
    showNotification(sprintf("\u2192 Next suggested: %s", ranked[1L, "star"]),
                     type = "message", duration = 6)
  })
  
  # Discard the tagging session without touching the database
  observeEvent(input$cancel_tagging, {
    tag_mode(FALSE)
    tag_windows(list())
    tag_labels(list())
  })

  # --- PHT-style one-click actions -------------------------------------------

  # "No Transit (Done)": marks this star as explicitly checked with nothing seen,
  # saves a no_transit row immediately (without entering tagging mode), and
  # auto-advances to the next bandit-recommended star.
  observeEvent(input$no_transit, {
    req(credentials()$user_auth, !isTRUE(tag_mode()))
    username <- user_info()$name
    id <- current_star_id()
    ts <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S")
    dbExecute(db_conn, "DELETE FROM user_star WHERE user_id = ? AND kepler_id = ?;",
              params = list(username, id))
    dbExecute(db_conn,
      "INSERT INTO user_star (user_id, kepler_id, start, end, label, flagged, classified_at) VALUES (?, ?, 0, 0, 'no_transit', 0, ?);",
      params = list(username, id, ts))
    refresh_saved_indices()
    session_counts$n_no_transit <- isolate(session_counts$n_no_transit) + 1L
    tag_save_trigger(isolate(tag_save_trigger()) + 1)
    showNotification("No Transit recorded.", type = "message", duration = 3)
    ranked <- rank_stars_by_bandit(db_conn, options)
    updateSelectInput(session, "kplr_id", selected = ranked[1L, "star"])
  })

  # "Next Star": jump to bandit-suggested next star without saving anything.
  observeEvent(input$next_star, {
    req(credentials()$user_auth)
    ranked <- rank_stars_by_bandit(db_conn, options)
    updateSelectInput(session, "kplr_id", selected = ranked[1L, "star"])
  })

  # "Flag for Discussion": toggles the flagged column in user_star for this
  # user/star pair. Upserts: inserts a placeholder row if none exists yet.
  observeEvent(input$flag_discussion, {
    req(credentials()$user_auth)
    new_val  <- !isTRUE(star_flagged())
    username <- user_info()$name
    id       <- current_star_id()
    ts       <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S")
    existing_n <- tryCatch(
      dbGetQuery(db_conn,
        "SELECT count(*) AS n FROM user_star WHERE user_id = ? AND kepler_id = ?;",
        params = list(username, id))$n,
      error = function(e) 0L)
    if (!is.finite(existing_n)) existing_n <- 0L
    if (existing_n > 0L) {
      dbExecute(db_conn,
        "UPDATE user_star SET flagged = ? WHERE user_id = ? AND kepler_id = ?;",
        params = list(as.integer(new_val), username, id))
    } else {
      dbExecute(db_conn,
        "INSERT INTO user_star (user_id, kepler_id, start, end, label, flagged, classified_at) VALUES (?, ?, 0, 0, NULL, ?, ?);",
        params = list(username, id, as.integer(new_val), ts))
    }
    star_flagged(new_val)
    tag_save_trigger(isolate(tag_save_trigger()) + 1)
    showNotification(
      if (new_val) "\u2691 Flagged for discussion." else "Flag removed.",
      type = if (new_val) "warning" else "message", duration = 3)
  })
  
  # Zoom in (+50%)
  observeEvent(input$zoom_in, {
    req(input$kplr_id)
    file <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = input$kplr_id, full.names = TRUE)[1]
    if(!is.na(file) && file.exists(file)) {
      raw_df <- read_kepler_table(file)
      cleaned_df <- clean_light_curve(raw_df)
      split_res <- split_train_test(cleaned_df, train_ratio = train_ratio, seq_len = seq_len)
      tot_len <- length(split_res$y_test)
      cur_lim <- if(is.null(zoom_state$xlim)) c(1, tot_len) else zoom_state$xlim
      mid <- (cur_lim[1] + cur_lim[2]) / 2
      half <- (cur_lim[2] - cur_lim[1]) / 4
      if(half >= 3) {
        zoom_state$xlim <- c(floor(max(1, mid - half)), ceiling(min(tot_len, mid + half)))
      }
    }
  })
  
  # Zoom out (-50%)
  observeEvent(input$zoom_out, {
    req(input$kplr_id)
    file <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = input$kplr_id, full.names = TRUE)[1]
    if(!is.na(file) && file.exists(file)) {
      raw_df <- read_kepler_table(file)
      cleaned_df <- clean_light_curve(raw_df)
      split_res <- split_train_test(cleaned_df, train_ratio = train_ratio, seq_len = seq_len)
      tot_len <- length(split_res$y_test)
      cur_lim <- if(is.null(zoom_state$xlim)) c(1, tot_len) else zoom_state$xlim
      mid <- (cur_lim[1] + cur_lim[2]) / 2
      half <- (cur_lim[2] - cur_lim[1])
      new_st <- max(1, floor(mid - half))
      new_en <- min(tot_len, ceiling(mid + half))
      if(new_st <= 1 && new_en >= tot_len) {
        zoom_state$xlim <- NULL
      } else {
        zoom_state$xlim <- c(new_st, new_en)
      }
    }
  })
  
  # Reset zoom to full light curve
  observeEvent(input$zoom_reset, {
    zoom_state$xlim <- NULL
  })
  
  # Run a BLS (Box Least Squares) period search on the full light curve for
  # the selected star, using whichever windows are currently "live" - the
  # in-progress tag_windows() while tagging, otherwise the star's saved (or
  # model-detected) windows - as a duration hint. Read-only: does not touch
  # user_star / test_idx, it only estimates period/duration/depth for
  # on-screen verification.
  observeEvent(input$verify_period, {
    req(input$kplr_id)
    file <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = input$kplr_id, full.names = TRUE)[1]
    if (is.na(file) || !file.exists(file)) return(invisible(NULL))
    
    windows <- if (isTRUE(tag_mode())) isolate(tag_windows()) else indices_to_windows(isolate(saved_indices()))
    
    result <- withProgress(message = "Running BLS period search...", value = 0.2, {
      raw_df <- read_kepler_table(file)
      cleaned_df <- clean_light_curve(raw_df)
      split_res <- split_train_test(cleaned_df, train_ratio = train_ratio, seq_len = seq_len)
      test_vec <- flatten_chronological(split_res$y_test)
      incProgress(0.3, detail = "Scanning trial periods")
      # Tries GPU-accelerated cuvarbase via reticulate first, transparently
      # falling back to the pure-R implementation - see run_bls_search_auto().
      out <- run_bls_search_auto(flux = test_vec, windows = windows, cadence_days = cadence_days)
      incProgress(0.3, detail = "Running odd-even / secondary-eclipse vetting checks")
      if (!is.null(out)) {
        vetting_result(run_vetting_checks(test_vec, out, cadence_days = cadence_days))
      } else {
        vetting_result(NULL)
      }
      incProgress(0.2, detail = "Done")
      out
    })
    
    if (is.null(result)) {
      showNotification("Not enough data (or no clear dip) to run a period search on this star.", type = "warning")
      bls_result(NULL)
    } else {
      bls_result(result)
    }
  })
  
  user_info <- reactive({
    return(credentials()$info)
  })
  
  output$welcome <- renderText({
    req(credentials()$user_auth)
    return(glue("Welcome {user_info()$name}"))
  })
  
  # Remove saved tags and revert to model-detected candidates (immediate,
  # does not go through a tagging session)
  observeEvent(input$reset, {
    dbExecute(db_conn, "DELETE FROM user_star WHERE user_id = ? AND kepler_id = ?;",
              params = list(user_info()$name, current_star_id()))
    tag_mode(FALSE)
    tag_windows(list())
    tag_labels(list())
    refresh_saved_indices()
    tag_save_trigger(isolate(tag_save_trigger()) + 1)
  })

  output$session_counter <- renderUI({
    req(credentials()$user_auth)
    tag_save_trigger()
    n_t  <- session_counts$n_transit
    n_nt <- session_counts$n_no_transit
    total <- n_t + n_nt
    if (total == 0L) return(NULL)
    div(style = "font-size: 0.8em; color: #aaa; line-height: 1.5;",
        sprintf("Session: %d classified", total), br(),
        sprintf("%d transit \u2022 %d no-transit", n_t, n_nt))
  })
  
  # Single reactive plot. Reads kplr_id, zoom, tag_mode reactively;
  # reads tag_windows via isolate() + tag_redraw_trigger so live edge-drags
  # don't force a full rebuild. Uses star_data_cache to avoid re-running
  # score_star() on every zoom or window change.
  output$trainPlot <- renderPlotly({
    req(credentials()$user_auth, input$kplr_id)
    kplr_id_val <- input$kplr_id
    in_tag_mode <- isTRUE(tag_mode())
    tag_redraw_trigger()
    xlim_dep <- zoom_state$xlim
    
    file <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = kplr_id_val, full.names = TRUE)[1]
    if (is.na(file) || !file.exists(file)) return(NULL)
    
    out_base  <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file))
    dir.create(plots_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
    plot_file <- file.path(plots_dir, paste0(out_base, "_test_plot.png"))
    
    mdl_candidates <- c(
      dl_model_candidate_paths("trained_models", out_base),
      dl_model_candidate_paths("../trained_models", out_base)
    )
    
    # Use per-star cache to skip model inference on zoom/tag-only re-renders
    cache <- isolate(star_data_cache())
    if (!is.null(cache[[kplr_id_val]])) {
      score <- cache[[kplr_id_val]]
    } else {
      score <- score_star(
        tbl_file = file, trained_model_paths = mdl_candidates,
        db_conn = db_conn, plot_file = plot_file,
        seq_len = seq_len, train_ratio = train_ratio, cadence_days = cadence_days
      )
      cache[[kplr_id_val]] <- score
      star_data_cache(cache)
    }
    y_test   <- score$y_test
    y_pred   <- score$y_pred
    test_vec <- score$test_vec
    model_fallback_state(score$fallback_reason)
    triage_state(score$triage)
    
    # Anomaly mask for VIEW mode (red dots at saved-tag / model-detected cadences)
    idx_mask  <- rep(FALSE, length(test_vec))
    cur_saved <- isolate(saved_indices())
    if (length(cur_saved$starts) > 0L && any(cur_saved$starts > 0L)) {
      for (j in seq_along(cur_saved$starts)) {
        st <- cur_saved$starts[j]
        en <- min(cur_saved$ends[j], length(test_vec))
        if (st > 0L && en >= st) idx_mask[st:en] <- TRUE
      }
    }
    
    xlim <- if (is.null(xlim_dep)) c(1L, length(test_vec)) else xlim_dep
    sub_flux <- test_vec[max(1L, xlim[1]):min(length(test_vec), xlim[2])]
    ylim <- if (length(sub_flux) > 0L && any(is.finite(sub_flux))) {
      fl_min <- min(sub_flux, na.rm = TRUE); fl_max <- max(sub_flux, na.rm = TRUE)
      pad <- max(0.05 * (fl_max - fl_min), 0.001)
      c(fl_min - pad, fl_max + pad)
    } else NULL
    
    title_str <- paste("Kepler Light Curve -", out_base,
      if (!is.null(xlim_dep)) sprintf("[Zoomed: %.1f\u2013%.1f d]",
        (xlim[1]-1L)*cadence_days, (xlim[2]-1L)*cadence_days) else "",
      if (in_tag_mode) " [Tagging Mode]" else "")
    
    pred_vec    <- flatten_chronological(y_pred)
    cur_windows <- isolate(tag_windows())
    cur_labels  <- isolate(tag_labels())
    
    # In view mode load saved windows + labels for non-editable overlay
    view_windows <- if (!in_tag_mode) indices_to_windows(isolate(saved_indices())) else list()
    view_labels  <- if (!in_tag_mode && length(view_windows) > 0L) {
      lbl_res <- tryCatch(
        dbGetQuery(db_conn,
          "SELECT start, label FROM user_star WHERE user_id = ? AND kepler_id = ? AND start > 0 ORDER BY start;",
          params = list(isolate(user_info()$name), isolate(current_star_id()))),
        error = function(e) data.frame(start = integer(0), label = character(0)))
      if (nrow(lbl_res) == 0L) {
        lbl_res <- tryCatch(
          dbGetQuery(db_conn,
            "SELECT start, label FROM test_idx WHERE id = ? AND start > 0 ORDER BY start;",
            params = list(isolate(current_star_id()))),
          error = function(e) data.frame(start = integer(0), label = character(0)))
      }
      if (nrow(lbl_res) > 0L) {
        lv <- lbl_res$label
        lv[is.na(lv) | !nzchar(lv)] <- "Transit"
        as.list(lv)
      } else rep(list("Transit"), length(view_windows))
    } else list()
    
    build_light_curve_plotly(
      test_vec = test_vec, pred_vec = pred_vec,
      xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim, idx_mask = idx_mask,
      title_str = title_str,
      mode = if (in_tag_mode) "tag" else "view",
      tag_windows_list = if (in_tag_mode) cur_windows else view_windows,
      tag_labels_list  = if (in_tag_mode) cur_labels  else view_labels,
      cadence_days = cadence_days
    )
  })
  
  output$planet_page <- renderUI({
    req(credentials()$user_auth)
    return(fluidPage(
      fluidRow(
        column(width = 12,
          uiOutput("model_fallback_banner")
        )
      ),
      fluidRow(
        column(width = 12,
          plotlyOutput("trainPlot", height = "520px")
        )
      ),
      br(),
      fluidRow(
        column(width = 12,
          uiOutput("toolbar")
        )
      ),
      fluidRow(
        column(width = 12,
          uiOutput("bls_panel")
        )
      ),
      fluidRow(
        column(width = 12,
          uiOutput("community_tags_panel")
        )
      )
    ))
  })

  # Visible warning banner for whenever the plot above is showing the
  # zero-baseline fallback instead of a real model prediction (no model
  # file on disk, Keras/reticulate unavailable, or the model failed to
  # load/run) - so it is never mistaken for a genuine result.
  output$model_fallback_banner <- renderUI({
    req(credentials()$user_auth)
    reason <- model_fallback_state()
    if (is.null(reason)) return(NULL)
    
    if (identical(reason, "triage_skip")) {
      # Not a degraded result - the fast pre-model triage scan found no
      # statistically plausible dip at all, so the (comparatively expensive)
      # model load/inference was skipped on purpose. Shown as neutral/
      # informational rather than a warning, distinct from the three
      # reasons below where the model genuinely couldn't be run.
      tr <- triage_state()
      n_pts <- if (!is.null(tr) && is.finite(tr$n_candidate_points)) tr$n_candidate_points else 0
      return(div(style = "background:#e7f1ff; border:1px solid #b6d4fe; color:#084298; border-radius:6px; padding:8px 14px; margin-bottom:12px; font-size:0.9em; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;",
        icon("bolt"),
        strong("Fast triage:"),
        sprintf("no plausible dip found (%d candidate point%s below threshold) \u2014 full model skipped to save compute.",
                n_pts, if (identical(n_pts, 1L)) "" else "s")
      ))
    }
    
    msg <- switch(reason,
      "no_model"   = "No trained model found for this star (star-specific or global fallback) \u2014 showing a flat zero baseline, not a real prediction.",
      "no_backend" = sprintf("The %s backend is not available on this server \u2014 showing a flat zero baseline, not a real prediction.",
                             if (identical(dl_backend(), "torch")) "PyTorch/reticulate" else "Keras/reticulate"),
      "load_error" = "A trained model file exists for this star but failed to load or run \u2014 showing a flat zero baseline, not a real prediction.",
      "Showing a flat zero baseline, not a real model prediction.")
    div(style = "background:#fff3cd; border:1px solid #ffe69c; color:#664d03; border-radius:6px; padding:8px 14px; margin-bottom:12px; font-size:0.9em; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;",
        icon("triangle-exclamation"),
        strong("Fallback baseline in use:"), msg
    )
  })
  
  # Toggled by the "View/Hide Community Tags" toolbar button. Aggregates
  # every human tagger's saved windows for the current star into merged
  # regions, each annotated with how many (and which) taggers agree on it
  # and whether the model's own test_idx detection also covers it - so a
  # single user is no longer limited to seeing just their own tags (or the
  # model default) in isolation.
  output$community_tags_panel <- renderUI({
    req(credentials()$user_auth, input$kplr_id)
    if (!isTRUE(community_tags_visible())) return(NULL)
    tag_save_trigger()
    
    id         <- current_star_id()
    human_sets <- get_star_human_tag_sets(db_conn, id)
    model_set  <- get_star_model_tag_set(db_conn, id)
    n_human    <- length(human_sets)
    regions    <- build_community_regions(human_sets)
    
    # Check if any user has flagged this star for discussion
    flagged_users <- tryCatch(
      dbGetQuery(db_conn,
        "SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM user_star WHERE kepler_id = ? AND flagged = 1;",
        params = list(id)),
      error = function(e) data.frame(user_id = character(0)))
    any_flagged <- nrow(flagged_users) > 0L
    
    body <- if (nrow(regions) == 0L) {
      tags$p(style = "color:#777; font-style:italic; margin: 6px 0 0 0;",
             if (n_human == 0L) "No one has tagged this star yet \u2014 be the first!"
             else "Every tagger for this star marked \u201cno transit\u201d \u2014 no candidate windows to show.")
    } else {
      merged_model <- merge_windows(model_set)
      regions$model_match <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(regions)), function(i) {
        windows_intersection_length(list(c(regions$start[i], regions$end[i])), merged_model) > 0
      }, logical(1))
      regions <- regions[order(-regions$n_taggers, regions$start), ]
      
      tags$table(class = "table table-striped table-condensed",
                 style = "width:100%; font-size:0.85em; margin-top:8px;",
        tags$thead(tags$tr(
          tags$th("Window (days)"), tags$th("Agreement"), tags$th("Tagged by"), tags$th("Matches model?")
        )),
        tags$tbody(
          lapply(seq_len(nrow(regions)), function(i) {
            r <- regions[i, ]
            d0 <- round((r$start - 1L) * cadence_days, 2)
            d1 <- round((r$end   - 1L) * cadence_days, 2)
            tags$tr(
              tags$td(title = sprintf("Cadence index %d\u2013%d", r$start, r$end),
                      sprintf("%.2f\u2013%.2f d", d0, d1)),
              tags$td(sprintf("%d / %d", r$n_taggers, n_human)),
              tags$td(r$taggers),
              tags$td(if (r$model_match) icon("check", style = "color:#16a34a;")
                      else icon("minus", style = "color:#999;"))
            )
          })
        )
      )
    }
    
    div(style = "border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px; margin-bottom: 15px; background-color: #fafafa;",
      div(style = "display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:baseline;",
        tags$b("Community Tags"),
        if (any_flagged) tags$span(
          style = "background:#fef3c7; border:1px solid #fbbf24; border-radius:10px; padding:2px 8px; font-size:0.8em; color:#92400e;",
          "\u2691 Flagged by: ", paste(flagged_users$user_id, collapse = ", ")
        ) else NULL
      ),
      tags$p(style = "margin: 6px 0 0 0; font-size: 0.85em; color: #777;",
             sprintf("%d user%s tagged this star so far.", n_human, if (n_human == 1L) "" else "s")),
      body
    )
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$toggle_community_tags, {
    community_tags_visible(!isTRUE(community_tags_visible()))
  })
  
  output$toolbar <- renderUI({
    is_flagged <- isTRUE(star_flagged())
    lbl_last   <- last_window_label()   # persists across re-renders
    comm_lbl   <- if (isTRUE(community_tags_visible())) " Hide Community Tags" else " View Community Tags"

    if (isTRUE(tag_mode())) {
      # ---- TAGGING MODE TOOLBAR ----
      div(style = "display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 15px;",

        bsButton("fix_brush", label = " Fix Brush as Window", icon = icon("thumbtack"), style = "primary"),
        bsTooltip(id = "fix_brush",
          title = "Drag-select a range on the plot, then click here to fix it as a tagged window",
          placement = "top", trigger = "hover"),

        # Label picker: choose the signal type for the NEXT window
        div(style = "display:flex; align-items:center; gap:4px;",
            tags$small(style = "color:#555; white-space:nowrap;", "Label:"),
            selectInput("window_label", NULL,
                        choices = c("Transit", "Sinusoidal", "Flare", "Odd-Even", "Uncertain"),
                        selected = lbl_last, width = "130px")),

        bsButton("undo_window", label = " Undo", icon = icon("undo"), style = "info"),
        bsTooltip(id = "undo_window", title = "Remove the most recently fixed window",
                  placement = "top", trigger = "hover"),

        span(style = "margin-left:8px; border-left:2px solid #ddd; height:32px; margin-right:8px;"),

        bsButton("zoom_in",    label = " +", icon = icon("plus"),       style = "info"),
        bsButton("zoom_out",   label = " \u2212", icon = icon("minus"), style = "info"),
        bsButton("zoom_reset", label = " Reset", icon = icon("expand"), style = "default"),

        span(style = "margin-left:8px; border-left:2px solid #ddd; height:32px; margin-right:8px;"),

        bsButton("confirm_tags", label = " Confirm Tags", icon = icon("check"), style = "success"),
        bsTooltip(id = "confirm_tags", title = "Save all fixed windows to your tagged data",
                  placement = "top", trigger = "hover"),

        bsButton("cancel_tagging", label = " Cancel", icon = icon("times"), style = "danger"),
        bsTooltip(id = "cancel_tagging", title = "Discard this tagging session without saving",
                  placement = "top", trigger = "hover"),

        span(style = "margin-left:8px; border-left:2px solid #ddd; height:32px; margin-right:8px;"),

        bsButton("flag_discussion",
                 label = if (is_flagged) " Flagged \u2691" else " Flag \u2690",
                 icon  = icon("flag"),
                 style = if (is_flagged) "danger" else "default"),
        bsTooltip(id = "flag_discussion",
                  title = "Toggle flag for community discussion",
                  placement = "top", trigger = "hover"),

        span(style = "margin-left:8px; border-left:2px solid #ddd; height:32px; margin-right:8px;"),

        bsButton("verify_period", label = " Verify Period (BLS)", icon = icon("wave-square"), style = "default"),
        bsTooltip(id = "verify_period",
                  title = "Run Box Least Squares on the full light curve using the fixed windows as a duration hint",
                  placement = "top", trigger = "hover"),

        span(style = "margin-left:8px; border-left:2px solid #ddd; height:32px; margin-right:8px;"),

        bsButton("toggle_community_tags", label = comm_lbl, icon = icon("users"), style = "default"),
        bsTooltip(id = "toggle_community_tags",
                  title = "See how other users have tagged this star",
                  placement = "top", trigger = "hover"),

        div(style = "width:100%; margin-top:6px; font-size:0.9em; color:#555;",
            textOutput("tag_window_summary")),
        div(style = "width:100%; font-size:0.82em; color:#888;",
            "Colours: ",
            tags$span(style="color:rgba(217,119,6,1);", "\u25a0 Transit "),
            tags$span(style="color:rgba(109,40,217,1);", "\u25a0 Sinusoidal "),
            tags$span(style="color:rgba(185,28,28,1);", "\u25a0 Flare "),
            tags$span(style="color:rgba(13,148,136,1);", "\u25a0 Odd-Even "),
            tags$span(style="color:rgba(107,114,128,1);", "\u25a0 Uncertain"),
            br(),
            "Drag an edge of a fixed window to resize it, or drag its body to move it. Drag on empty space to select a new range."
        )
      )
    } else {
      # ---- VIEW MODE TOOLBAR ----
      div(style = "display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 15px;",

        # Primary PHT-style actions
        bsButton("no_transit", label = " No Transit (Done)", icon = icon("check-circle"), style = "success"),
        bsTooltip(id = "no_transit",
                  title = "I see no transit \u2014 saves your review and auto-advances to the next star",
                  placement = "top", trigger = "hover"),

        bsButton("next_star", label = " Next Star", icon = icon("arrow-right"), style = "primary"),
        bsTooltip(id = "next_star",
                  title = "Jump to the bandit-recommended next star without saving",
                  placement = "top", trigger = "hover"),

        span(style = "margin-left:10px; border-left:2px solid #ddd; height:32px; margin-right:10px;"),

        bsButton("zoom_brush", label = " Zoom to Selection", icon = icon("search-plus"), style = "default"),
        bsTooltip(id = "zoom_brush", title = "Zoom into the drag-selected range",
                  placement = "top", trigger = "hover"),
        bsButton("zoom_in",    label = " +",      icon = icon("plus"),   style = "info"),
        bsButton("zoom_out",   label = " \u2212", icon = icon("minus"),  style = "info"),
        bsButton("zoom_reset", label = " Reset",  icon = icon("expand"), style = "default"),

        span(style = "margin-left:10px; border-left:2px solid #ddd; height:32px; margin-right:10px;"),

        bsButton("start_tagging", label = " Edit Tags",   icon = icon("pencil-alt"), style = "warning"),
        bsTooltip(id = "start_tagging",
                  title = "Start a manual tagging session pre-loaded with your saved tags",
                  placement = "top", trigger = "hover"),

        bsButton("customize", label = " Start Blank", icon = icon("eraser"), style = "warning"),
        bsTooltip(id = "customize",
                  title = "Start a manual tagging session with a blank slate",
                  placement = "top", trigger = "hover"),

        bsButton("reset", label = "Reset to Model", icon = icon("undo"), style = "danger"),
        bsTooltip(id = "reset",
                  title = "Remove saved tags and revert to model-detected candidates",
                  placement = "top", trigger = "hover"),

        span(style = "margin-left:10px; border-left:2px solid #ddd; height:32px; margin-right:10px;"),

        bsButton("flag_discussion",
                 label = if (is_flagged) " Flagged \u2691" else " Flag \u2690",
                 icon  = icon("flag"),
                 style = if (is_flagged) "danger" else "default"),
        bsTooltip(id = "flag_discussion",
                  title = "Toggle flag for community discussion",
                  placement = "top", trigger = "hover"),

        span(style = "margin-left:10px; border-left:2px solid #ddd; height:32px; margin-right:10px;"),

        bsButton("verify_period", label = " Verify Period (BLS)", icon = icon("wave-square"), style = "default"),
        bsTooltip(id = "verify_period",
                  title = "Run Box Least Squares on the full light curve using the current tagged windows as a duration hint",
                  placement = "top", trigger = "hover"),

        span(style = "margin-left:10px; border-left:2px solid #ddd; height:32px; margin-right:10px;"),

        bsButton("toggle_community_tags", label = comm_lbl, icon = icon("users"), style = "default"),
        bsTooltip(id = "toggle_community_tags",
                  title = "See how other users have tagged this star",
                  placement = "top", trigger = "hover")
      )
    }
  })
  
  # Summary panel + phase-folded verification plot for the most recent BLS
  # period search on the selected star. Hidden (NULL) until a search has
  # been run for the current star (see observeEvent(input$verify_period)).
  output$bls_panel <- renderUI({
    res <- bls_result()
    if (is.null(res)) return(NULL)
    vet <- vetting_result()
    
    engine_label <- if (identical(res$engine, "gpu")) "GPU (cuvarbase)" else "CPU (R)"
    
    vetting_rows <- list()
    if (!is.null(vet) && !is.null(vet$odd_even)) {
      oe <- vet$odd_even
      vetting_rows[[length(vetting_rows) + 1]] <- tags$li(
        sprintf("Odd-even depth difference: %.2fσ (%d odd, %d even transit%s)",
                if (is.finite(oe$diff_sigma)) oe$diff_sigma else NA, oe$n_odd_transits, oe$n_even_transits,
                if (oe$n_even_transits == 1) "" else "s"),
        if (isTRUE(oe$flag_likely_eb)) tags$span(style = "color:#dc2626; font-weight:bold; margin-left:6px;", "⚠ possible eclipsing binary") else NULL
      )
    }
    if (!is.null(vet) && !is.null(vet$secondary_eclipse)) {
      se <- vet$secondary_eclipse
      vetting_rows[[length(vetting_rows) + 1]] <- tags$li(
        sprintf("Secondary eclipse: %.2fσ above noise at phase ~0.5", if (is.finite(se$depth_sigma)) se$depth_sigma else NA),
        if (isTRUE(se$flag_likely_eb)) tags$span(style = "color:#dc2626; font-weight:bold; margin-left:6px;", "⚠ possible eclipsing binary") else NULL
      )
    }
    
    div(style = "border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px; margin-bottom: 15px; background-color: #fafafa;",
      tags$b("BLS Period Verification"),
      tags$span(style = "float:right; font-size:0.8em; color:#777; border:1px solid #ddd; border-radius:10px; padding:2px 8px;", engine_label),
      tags$p(style = "margin: 6px 0 10px 0; font-size: 0.85em; color: #777;",
             "Heuristic Box Least Squares search over the full light curve \u2014 a quick sanity check, not a publication-grade period search."),
      fluidRow(
        column(width = 3, tags$b("Period:"), br(), sprintf("%.3f days", res$period_days)),
        column(width = 3, tags$b("Duration:"), br(), sprintf("%.3f days", res$duration_days)),
        column(width = 3, tags$b("Depth:"), br(),
               if (is.na(res$depth_pct)) sprintf("%.4f", res$depth) else sprintf("%.4f (%.2f%% of baseline)", res$depth, res$depth_pct)),
        column(width = 3, tags$b("Signal strength:"), br(), sprintf("%.2f", res$snr))
      ),
      plotlyOutput("phaseFoldPlot", height = "320px"),
      if (length(vetting_rows) > 0) tagList(
        tags$hr(style = "margin: 10px 0;"),
        tags$b("Vetting checks", style = "font-size:0.9em;"),
        tags$ul(style = "font-size:0.85em; color:#555; margin-top:4px;", vetting_rows)
      ) else NULL
    )
  })
  
  output$phaseFoldPlot <- renderPlotly({
    res <- bls_result()
    req(res)
    build_phase_fold_plotly(res)
  })
  
  output$login_page <- renderUI({
    if(!credentials()$user_auth) {
      return(
        tabBox(tabPanel("Login", shinyauthr::loginUI(id = "login",
                                                     title = "Login to access exoplanet dashboard")),
               tabPanel("Signup", fluidPage(
                 fluidRow(
                   textInput(inputId = "user", label = "Username"),
                   textInput(inputId = "name", "Name"),
                   textInput(inputId = "password", label = "Password"),
                   selectInput(inputId = "permissions", label = "Permissions", choices = c("admin", "standard"), selected = "standard"),
                   actionButton(inputId = "signup", label = "Signup", icon = icon("user-plus")),
                   uiOutput("error")
                 )))))
    }
  })
})
